description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, Vanilla and SepLLM, as they train for up to 250,000 seconds. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents Loss, also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The Vanilla model is represented by a purple line with dashed segments and star markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The SepLLM model is represented by a red line with circular markers, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.48 by 250,000 seconds. A green dashed box highlights the region from 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, with a green arrow indicating that the loss for SepLLM at 250,000 seconds is 1.26 times the loss of Vanilla at 250,000 seconds. A green horizontal line is drawn at a loss value of 2.50.
